get.summary: Liveness/readiness probe; verifies the database answers `SELECT 1`.

AcceptedChangeDto.description: A confirmed (possibly edited) change sent to `apply`.

price.description: Whole TWD dollars; required (fill in `price_missing` items first).

oneOf.description:
`null`/absent leaves the vendor info alone (required for a new vendor,
whose name is `info.name`; existing vendors are never renamed).

accepted.description: The changes the user confirmed (possibly edited); anything not listed is ignored.

aiDemo.description: Whether AI import runs on scripted demo data (show a "demo mode" badge).

aiImportEnabled.description: Whether AI import is available (an API key or the demo agent is configured).

devLoginEnabled.description: Whether the development-only login form is available.

ClientViewDto.description: Device metadata of a submission. The raw `User-Agent` and the full device id are never exposed.

deviceShort.description: First 3 characters of the device id.

deadlineAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp; must be in the future.

cancelled.description: The latest submission had no lines.

orderedCount.description: Participants whose effective order has at least one line.

shareUrl.description: `APP_BASE_URL/g/<token>`; the link to post in the chat.

GroupStatusDto.description: Lifecycle status of a group order.

items.description: Every offered item in menu order (quantity 0 included).

itemId.description: The offered item this line orders.

input.description: The item name as sent in the request.
The name as sent in the request.

idempotencyKey.description: One per "send" press; a retry with the same key is a no-op.

lines.description: At most 30 lines; empty cancels the order.

itemId.description: The offered item this line orders.

amountDue.description: Total of the effective order (0 when none or cancelled).

balance.description: `amountDue - paidAmount`: positive = 尚差, negative = 應退, 0 = settled; `null` when unpaid.

deviceShort.description: First 3 characters of the latest submission's device id.

paidAmount.description: Amount due recorded when marked paid.

submittedAt.description: When the effective order was submitted; `null` if never.

suspiciousDevice.description: A device id used by this participant was also used for another participant in this group.

deadlineAt.description: Absent = keep, `null` = clear, RFC 3339 = set (must be in the future).

oneOf.description: open -> closed -> open/archived. Same status is a no-op; anything else is 422 `invalid_status`.

PatchVendorRequest.description: Merge-patch: absent = keep, `null` = clear, string = set.

errors.description: Per-entry validation errors (apply of an AI import).

existingId.description: Id of the existing record that caused a uniqueness conflict.

field.description: Offending request field (validation and conflict errors).

runId.description: Id of the AI import run that failed (so the UI can still show it).

type.description: URI reference identifying the problem type.

ProposalDto.description: Pending changes proposed by the AI; nothing is written until applied.

price.description: `null` = the price could not be read (issue `price_missing`).

acceptingOrders.description: Open and not past the deadline.

hasOrdered.description: The effective order has at least one line.

image.description: JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 5 MB (detected from the bytes, not the file name).

targetRosterId.description: Existing roster to add the members to.

effective.description: This is the participant's latest submission (the one that counts).

sharedDeviceWith.description: Names of other participants that used the same device id in this group.

idempotencyKey.description: One per "send" press; a retry with the same key is a no-op.

lines.description: At most 30 lines; empty cancels the order.

subtotal.description: Sum of `quantity * unitPrice` of the effective lines (stored prices).

ordered.description: Effective order has at least one line.

paidAmount.description: Sum of the `paidAmount` recorded when each participant was marked paid.

unpaidAmount.description:
`totalAmount` minus the current amount due of the participants marked paid:
what is still expected from those who have not paid. A paid participant whose
order changed afterwards contributes only their current due here; the
difference (尚差/應退) is their per-participant `balance`.
